answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the island of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the atlas of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
